statement: A base extension status edge conditionally clears Dolphin downstream ID and opens the F6 path, triggers kernel worker reinit, prompts SDL report selection but not necessarily reconnect while MP active, makes Cemu run FA probes, drives wiiuse handshakes, and reaches xwiimote only through the kernel. Status edges alone do not guarantee F6, post-map reports or decoded motion, and a speculative universal two-edge policy risks worker/SDL contention. Creation-time switchable transition is a compatible experiment, not verified faithful default.

applicability.revision: Original external MotionPlus and integrated Remote Plus distinguished where possible; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Synthesis of pinned sources; consider wii-w9f-dolphin-motionplus-nunchuk-on-result and wii-gap-dolphin-attach-passthrough-four-byte-id-f6. Source-only; all physical and proposed host experiments not run.
